script_line: The placement is the whole thing. A centimetre too high and it is a sleeve again.

risks.risk: the finger drifts onto the kneecap
risks.prevented_by: settles back on the same spot; no finger sliding onto the kneecap

risks.risk: the press moves or dents the strap
risks.prevented_by: the strap does not move; worn-constancy line; product negatives

risks.risk: the fingers fuse with the shell
risks.prevented_by: one light press, lifts a finger's width; NEG-WARP-C
